h1: Amylin analogs: pramlintide, cagrilintide and the amylin drugs in development
dek: Pramlintide is the only approved amylin analog; cagrilintide, eloralintide, petrelintide and amycretin are the long-acting amylin drugs in trials.
scope: Informational only. Label doses for pramlintide are reported as label facts; nothing is framed as personal dosing.
